guidance.title: Plan
guidance.text: Identify the original 100% and remove any separate delivery charge.

guidance.title: Method
guidance.text: For a reduction subtract the rate from 100%; for an increase add it. Divide the resulting percentage by 100 to form a multiplier, then divide the known amount by it.

guidance.title: Check
guidance.text: Apply any final quantity requested and check by applying the original percentage change.
